findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_gas" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cancel_limit_order · Private data: get_supported_tokens, get_quote, build_swap_tx, build_limit_order, list_limit_orders, scan_new_tokens, scan_trending, scan_movers, token_risk, get_wallet_balances, check_approvals, build_revoke_tx, explain_transaction, token_info, watch_token, check_watches, unwatch_token, get_yields, find_money, build_swap_link, wallet_history, wallet_pnl, token_pools, whale_watch, contract_reader, airdrop_check, rebalance_plan · Public sink: build_limit_order, cancel_limit_order · Destructive: unwatch_token, simulate_swap.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cancel_limit_order · Private data: get_supported_tokens, get_quote, build_swap_tx, build_limit_order, list_limit_orders, scan_new_tokens, scan_trending, scan_movers, token_risk, get_wallet_balances, check_approvals, build_revoke_tx, explain_transaction, token_info, watch_token, check_watches, unwatch_token, get_yields, find_money, build_swap_link, wallet_history, wallet_pnl, token_pools, whale_watch, contract_reader, airdrop_check, rebalance_plan · Public sink: build_limit_order, cancel_limit_order · Destructive: unwatch_token, simulate_swap

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
